summary: Tested Home Maintenance Scheduler feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed for /api/maintenance/* (generate idempotent + ~20 tasks, sorted list with statuses, summary shape/values, CRUD, recurring complete rolls forward + spent_ytd increases, once task removal, 401/403 on auth-gated endpoints). Frontend: empty-state Generate-My-Plan worked (20 tasks created, status card + annual budget bar shown, grouped OVERDUE/DUE THIS MONTH/UPCOMING). Completed a task via complete-<id> circle and list updated. Added a custom task via add-task FAB modal (filled title, picked freq-monthly chip, cost) — task appeared and annual budget recomputed from $655/yr to $955/yr. Tapping the row reopened the edit modal with prefilled values, edited title saved successfully, then task-delete removed it. Both entry points (home-maintenance banner and menu-maintenance hamburger item) navigate to /maintenance.

react_native_issues.issue: React console warning: 'A component is changing a controlled input to be uncontrolled' fires when opening the edit modal. Likely because EMPTY does not include a 'notes' key and the spread { ...t } for existing tasks may omit it too, causing TextInput value transitions between undefined and string. Reference: /app/frontend/app/maintenance.tsx:35 and lines 177/179/191/195. Suggest defaulting fields with ?? '' (e.g., value={editing?.title ?? ''}) or adding notes to EMPTY. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: default modal TextInput values with ?? '' to silence the controlled→uncontrolled React warning in /app/frontend/app/maintenance.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth-gated endpoints return 403 (Forbidden) instead of 401 when no token is supplied. Tests accept both; functionally fine but 401 is the conventional status for missing/invalid auth.
/api/maintenance/summary spent_ytd_cents filter uses str(date).startswith(year). Works for ISO dates only — fine here since dates are always stored as YYYY-MM-DD.
Recurring frequency 'biannual' and 'seasonal' both map to 182 days in FREQ_DAYS while FREQ_PER_YEAR=2 for both — consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: generate, complete, add, edit, delete, both entry points)

seed_data_creation: Tests register fresh TEST_maint_* users for each module to avoid cross-test pollution. The demo user demo_home@diyhomie.com now has 20 generated tasks + 1 completion from UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL or EXPO_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest. demo_home@diyhomie.com / Test1234 now has a populated maintenance plan; for empty-state generate flow, use a fresh register.
